blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A bill that aims to prevent malnutrition and hunger in children and adolescents is one step closer to becoming law after the Senate ratified it on Monday, and it is now awaiting transmission and approval by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. The proposed National Children’s Nutrition Act that reconciles provisions from Senate Bill No. 2272 and House Bill No. 9466 seeks to expand the existing Republic Act No. 11037, or the Masustansyang Pagkain para sa Batang Pilipino Act. If the new bill is passed, RA No. 11037 shall be repealed. Under the proposed measure, the Department of Social Welfare […]... Keep on reading: Senate ratifies National Children’s Nutrition bill
